I was also pleased to see Robert Mann nip in for the bronze in the Club C.C. as one of the band of very hard working boys who again persevere, often without immediate success.
John Neillis and Gary McGarren have run consistently well in the London Federation of Boys Clubs races while Robert Mann has returned several good performances for his local Scouts Group.
Not to be outdone the 'B string' runners showed consistent form to nail the Bronze in the Herne Hill League, largely from the efforts of Matthew Smith, Adam Horton and Robert Mann.
